result.summary: Several layout and content problems: restaurant names are clipped, a promo discount shows “-0%”, and the last restaurant card is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The third restaurant in “Fastest near you” has its name truncated (“Trattoria Piccol”) because the card is cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow the horizontal list to scroll fully or wrap/scale names so the full restaurant name is visible.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a “-0%” badge, which looks like a broken or empty discount.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is 0% or show a valid promotion value.

issues.description: The last restaurant card is clipped by the bottom tab bar, so the image and details are only partly visible.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/safe-area inset so cards sit fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: The category chips row is cut off on the right (partial “Healthy” chip and next item).
issues.suggestion: Make the chip row clearly scrollable with a peek of the next chip or add spacing so it doesn’t look accidentally cropped.

issues.description: Notification bell has a red badge with no visible count, so the alert is unclear.
issues.suggestion: Show a number or provide an accessible label describing how many notifications there are.
